plate_setback.formula: frontT + inset_mm - (frameT - frontT), from the CARCASS FRONT edge to the plate's fixing column
plate_setback.status: PROPOSED (CLAUDE.md T80 F6 and THE NUMBERS: 'frontT + 1.5 less 3 = 20.5', Blum inset rule, dealer page of 21.10)
plate_setback.quote: Installation Note : Set back mounting plate screw-on position by door thickness +1.5 mm. (SNIPPET)
plate_setback.caution: Blum's own pages word the rule as a shift FROM the standard 37 line ('Move back fixing position of mounting plate by front thickness FD + 1.5 mm', https://publications.blum.com/2024/catalogue/en/81/, SNIPPET; 'Setback of mounting plate would be 38.5 mm + door thickness', https://cabinotch.us/media/wysiwyg/FAQ/BlumHingeSpecifications.pdf, SNIPPET). Read that way, a door whose face stands 25 in front of the carcass puts the plate 37 + 1.5 + 22 - 25 = 35.5 from the carcass front, not 20.5 (T80's arithmetic, not a source). Blum recommends a trial door for inset use. The owner decides on a trial door before the column is drilled in production.
